description: This Vegetarian Mapo Tofu delivers all the fiery, numbing, and savory flavors of the classic Sichuan dish without any meat. Silken tofu cubes are bathed in a rich, spicy sauce, making it a truly satisfying and flavorful meal. It is a vibrant and aromatic experience that will transport your taste buds straight to China.

ingredients.notes: mixed with 2 tbsp water to create a slurry

instructions.title: Prepare Tofu and Sichuan Peppercorns
instructions.text: Gently press the tofu to remove excess water, then cut into 3/4-inch cubes. Bring a pot of water to a boil, add the tofu cubes, and blanch for 2-3 minutes. This firms up the tofu and removes any raw taste. Drain carefully and set aside. In a dry wok or skillet, toast the whole Sichuan peppercorns over medium-low heat for 2-3 minutes until fragrant. Remove, let cool, then finely crush them using a mortar and pestle or spice grinder. Set aside.

instructions.title: Sauté Aromatics and Chili Bean Paste
instructions.text: Heat vegetable oil in a wok or large skillet over medium heat until shimmering. Add the minced garlic and ginger, stir-fry for 30 seconds until fragrant. Add the chili bean paste (doubanjiang) and fermented black beans. Stir-fry for 2-3 minutes, pressing the paste against the wok to release its oils and aroma. The oil should turn red.

instructions.title: Build the Sauce Base
instructions.text: Pour in the vegetable broth, light soy sauce, dark soy sauce (if using), and sugar. Bring the mixture to a gentle simmer, stirring to combine all the flavors. Taste and adjust seasonings if necessary, keeping in mind the chili bean paste is already salty and spicy.

instructions.title: Add Tofu and Thicken the Sauce
instructions.text: Carefully add the blanched tofu cubes to the simmering sauce. Gently fold them in to coat without breaking them. Let the tofu simmer in the sauce for 3-5 minutes to absorb the flavors. Stir the cornstarch slurry once more, then slowly pour it into the simmering tofu, stirring gently until the sauce thickens to your desired consistency. You may not need all of it.

instructions.title: Finish with Sichuan Peppercorns and Sesame Oil
instructions.text: Remove the wok from heat. Stir in the sesame oil. Sprinkle about half to two-thirds of the crushed Sichuan peppercorns over the tofu. The remaining peppercorns can be saved for individual servings for those who prefer extra numbing spice. Gently fold once more.

instructions.title: Serve and Garnish
instructions.text: Transfer the Vegetarian Mapo Tofu to a serving dish. Garnish generously with chopped scallions. Serve immediately with steamed white rice for a complete and satisfying meal. Be prepared for a delightful kick of spice and numbing sensation!

tips: To enhance the numbing sensation (ma la), make sure to toast your Sichuan peppercorns until fragrant before crushing them. For an extra kick, add a drizzle of Sichuan chili oil at the end.
For a richer umami flavor, consider adding a pinch of mushroom powder or a splash of vegetarian oyster sauce to the broth.
Serve your Mapo Tofu immediately with freshly steamed jasmine rice. Leftovers can be stored in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days and reheated gently on the stovetop.
